notes: DRAFT for R-STANCE-e. The dojo stance list Jay approved (J1, Oct 25). Descriptions use only what the repo already says: the kata sheets and self-defense.md. How to stand in each stance (feet, weight, hands) is not written anywhere in the repo, so it is a jayQuestion, never a guess. Game benefits are in drafts/planning/R-STANCE-stances-and-kata-rewards.md, not here.

stances.name: Ready
stances.description: Where every kata starts and ends.
stances.source: Kata finishes: 'ready stance', 'move to attention & bow out'.
stances.jayQuestion: Are Ready stance and Attention one stance or two? The sheets name both ('ready stance', then 'move to attention'). What does each look like, in one short line?
stances.gameLine: Steady and even. Good at everything.

stances.name: Cat
stances.description: A short step back. It shows up in every kata so far.
stances.source: Basic Form 1-2, Keon, David and Goliath: 'short stepping to rear w/RF into cat stance'.
stances.jayQuestion: One short line on how to stand in cat stance, for kids.
stances.gameLine: Quicker Counters and Dash, but softer blocks.

stances.name: Front
stances.description: Step forward into it, ready to block and punch.
stances.source: Keon #3 and #9: 'step forward w/LF into front stance'.
stances.jayQuestion: One short line on how to stand in front stance, for kids.
stances.gameLine: Hit harder, but move a little slower.

stances.name: Fighting
stances.description: Jump into it to face a weapon, ready to kick.
stances.jayQuestion: One short line on how to stand in fighting stance, for kids. Is it used in any kata?
stances.gameLine: Strong blocks and fast Focus, but a shorter Dash.

stances.name: Horse
stances.source: Jay (Oct 25): 'horse stance is rooted stance'. Not in any sheet in the repo.
stances.jayQuestion: One short line on how to stand in horse stance, for kids. Which kata or belt teaches it?
stances.gameLine: Stand still to hit harder, but move slower.

jayQuestion: Are there other stances taught at the dojo (for example a back stance), and at which belt?
